summary.text: Brandy Tollefson is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 88, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Benjamin Franklin.
She has served on the De Pere School District Board of Education since 2024.

paragraphs.text: Brandy Tollefson holds an at-large seat on the De Pere School District Board of Education, which she assumed in 2024; her current term ends in 2027.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for Wisconsin State Assembly District 88 on August 11, 2026, receiving 6,402 votes.
